No supplied page states whether the revised conversion price must be no less than par value.
The supplied pages state one exercise per interest year after first satisfaction, but do not provide a separate annual exercise limit term beyond that rule.

The put clause uses a continuous thirty trading day observation window, but the schema field for put observation_window is unresolved because the supplied pages do not separately label it as an observation window term.
The put clause requires the closing price to be below 70% for at least fifteen trading days, but the supplied pages do not separately label a required_days term for the put clause.
The put clause uses 70% of the current conversion price, but the supplied pages do not separately label a trigger_ratio term for the put clause.
The supplied pages describe the down-revision trigger and adjustment-day calculation for the trigger window, but do not state a distinct adjustment_day_treatment term for the down-revision clause.

The put clause uses a continuous thirty trading day observation window, but the schema field for put observation_window is unresolved because the supplied pages do not separately label it as an observation window term.
The put clause requires the closing price to be below 70% for at least fifteen trading days, but the supplied pages do not separately label a required_days term for the put clause.
The put clause uses 70% of the current conversion price, but the supplied pages do not separately label a trigger_ratio term for the put clause.
The supplied pages provide the accrued interest formula for redemption, but do not state a separate accrued interest redemption rule term.
The supplied pages state the maturity redemption price as 115% of face value including final interest, but do not separately label a maturity redemption price rule term.
The supplied pages state redemption within five trading days after maturity, but do not separately label a maturity redemption window days term.
The conditional redemption clause uses a continuous thirty trading day observation window, but the supplied pages do not separately label it as an observation window term.
The conditional redemption clause requires at least fifteen trading days, but the supplied pages do not separately label a required_days term for redemption.
The conditional redemption clause uses 130% of the current conversion price, but the supplied pages do not separately label a trigger_ratio term for redemption.
